description: A league's schedule on a date: fixture ids, start times (UTC), teams, status (Scheduled, In Progress, Final, Postponed, ...), postponement links. Needs an API key.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD, or a range YYYY-MM-DD-YYYY-MM-DD of up to 31 days; the league's local date; default today

league.description: the league: mlb, nba, nfl, cfb (college football), nhl, epl (Premier League), bund (Bundesliga), laliga (LaLiga) or ucl (Champions League)

name: list_fixtures
